text: But what else has happened?” “Ah, the dear little kittens!” cried Mrs. Penniman. “I wouldn’t have them drowned for the world!” Her brother puffed his cigar a few moments in silence. “Your sympathy with kittens, Lavinia,” he presently resumed, “arises from a feline element in your own character.” “Cats are very graceful, and very clean,” said Mrs. Penniman, smiling. “And very stealthy. You are the embodiment both of grace and of neatness; but you are wanting in frankness.” “You certainly are not, dear brother.” “I don’t pretend to be graceful, though I try to be neat.
